description: Two men in three-cornered hats and dark long coats grab a wild-haired young man in a loose shirt and waistcoat on a narrow cobbled street at night. One officer pins his arm and holds a short wooden cane; the other holds a pair of open handcuffs. Brick townhouses, a lit lantern on a post, iron railings and a dim sky fill the scene. Painterly, dark, oil-paint style, edge to edge with no visible text.
